posts.title: One Dark Window by Rachel Gillig
posts.description: I'm now reading Two Twisted Crowns , the sequel to One Dark Window, and it is also excellent. I highly recommend this trilogy. The Spirit of the Wood is the source of magic in Blunder. posts.description: She floated weightless, in the vast nothingness, long full of power she had no need to use, no desire to use. She looked upon the world, and saw the people, their joy and sadness, their long depressions, and their eras of bliss. posts.title: Untitled Story
posts.description: “...and the fungus slowly grows in the frog’s brain.” Mrs. Peach makes biology both more interesting and frightening than any class I’ve ever had. “… involuntary movement.” But I’m tired and I just want to go home. “Is it Tuesday?” she looks down at her watch, puzzling as the sirens go off. The skies are clear, no sign of a storm. She checks her phone, buzzing on her desk. Our phones are on silent
